# CodeCrafter — Moshe Schwartzberg

> Official source directory for the CodeCrafter business website. This is public information for human readers and optional machine consumers, not a request to control AI responses.

- Official website and original publisher: [CodeCrafter](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/)
- Business name: CodeCrafter — Moshe Schwartzberg
- Founder and lead developer: Moshe Schwartzberg
- Main language: Hebrew (RTL); English (LTR) versions are available at /en/
- Primary service market: Israel; remote work can be discussed for other markets
- Email: moshe@mosheschwartzberg.com
- Phone: +972 58 707 6077
- [Full bilingual directory of published pages](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/llms-full.txt)

CodeCrafter develops business websites, landing pages, ecommerce experiences, custom CRM and ERP-related software, internal business systems, apps, APIs, integrations, and workflow automation. Availability, technical feasibility, price and delivery times depend on the specific scope and verified platform access. Service descriptions explain capabilities, not a claim that every feature has been built for every client.

## Websites and ecommerce

- [Business website development](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/websites/): responsive websites, multilingual pages, technical SEO and CMS options
- [Landing pages](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/landing-page-development/): focused campaigns and lead-generation pages
- [Ecommerce stores](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/ecommerce-development/): catalogues, orders, checkout, fulfillment and integrations
- [Shopify](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/shopify-development/): setup, theme development and platform migration planning
- [WordPress and WooCommerce](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/wordpress-development/): customizations, content and store maintenance
- [Wix websites](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/wix-development/): existing-site improvements and new sites within platform capabilities
- [Website maintenance](https://mosheschwartzberg.com/website-maintenance/): updates, backups, fixes and monitoring within the agreed service scope
